The Lord despised and rejected

Richard Crashaw (B.) (c. 1613–1649)

‘The Lord despised and rejected by His own people.’—L
UKE IV.
 
28, 29
.
S
EE,
 O my kinsmen, what strange thing is this!
Christ in’s own country a great stranger is.
The thief which bled upon the cross with Thee
Was more ally’d in consanguinity.
